pais.texto:
India is a country in South Asia. It is the seventh-largest country by area and the second-most populous country, after China.
The Taj Mahal is a mausoleum and the best known of the country’s monuments. It is classified by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site.

fotos.texto: Officially, English is the most important language of India. After Hindi, it is the most commonly spoken language.
The Indians have their own unique English. The Indian accent is sometimes difficult for non-Indians to understand.

lesson.vocabSub: for the video · pay attention to pronunciation

languageGame.question: There are only two languages in India.
The “Indian accent” is the way English is spoken in India.
The English vocabulary used in India is like the one used in the USA.
There are no changes in pronunciation in “Indian English”.

conversation.question: What images come to your mind when you think of India?
Why is India one of the top tourist destinations in the world?
Would you like to visit or live in India? Why (not)?
Which tourist attractions do you prefer to see when traveling? Historical places or natural landmarks? Why?
What is the most famous monument in Brazil? Why is it famous?
What good tourist sites in your country can you suggest to visit? Why?
Do you wish your country had another language instead of the present one? If so, which one? Why?
What does accent or dialect tell you about someone’s education, background, or income?
Are some languages more beautiful to listen to than others? Are there any languages that you really don’t like the sound of? Why?

evaluation.question: Did you enjoy talking about India?
Which other countries would you like to learn more about?
